acceptance_criteria.statement: FORBIDDEN_CLASSES contains gate, merge_lane, policy, rulesets, preauth, secrets, force_push, delete_data and deploy_without_rollback.
An envelope validates only with every required field, max_uses >= 1 and an expiry within 7 days of now.
may_act refuses every forbidden action class with preauth_forbidden_class.
conditions_met is true only when every named fact matches its value; a missing or unknown fact is false.
After max_uses recorded uses the next may_act refuses with preauth_exhausted.
A revoked envelope is refused on the next may_act call.
The digest counts uses by envelope and lists revocations for the day.

observable_behavior: conditions are proven from facts and fail closed
uses, exhaustion, revocation and the daily digest come from the ledger
outcome.summary: A checker that proves every envelope condition from data before acting, refuses the never-preauthorizable classes and expired/exhausted/revoked envelopes, and an append-only ledger that records each use with its evidence and feeds a daily digest.
